status_note: inputs, key, scorer and harness are prepared and tested offline; the run needs P3 and P4 fixed, the human-approved 16b transfer applied, the local stack up with the include list loaded, and the key-handling procedure; nothing has been run against a service
description: Q12: the 33-question benchmark (3 questions x 11 types: coauthor breadth, max team size, direct collaboration, shortest paths, components, communities, bridge researchers, temporal change, topics, institutions, evidence) asked with real answers through POST /v1/query against the LOCAL stack, and scored on retrieval, claims and answer text against the computed answer key. User decisions 2026-11-16 (docs/agent-runs/phase-15/prompt.md): Q12 cannot be dropped; mode (b) with all 33 questions answered for real; run after P3 and P4 are fixed.

llm.draws_from: bucket 16b of the shared claude-haiku-5-5 cap USD 1.33 (experiments/manifests/llm-allocation.json): 33 answers x USD 0.001365 = USD 0.045045 is a LOWER BOUND (the pinned estimate per answer, not metered)

cost_bounds_usd.typical_estimate: about 0.08 (reviewer estimate: after P3 and P4 the direct-coauthor and path answers carry larger evidence, about 1.5 to 5 times the unit)
cost_bounds_usd.worst_estimate: about 0.24 (reviewer estimate, all 33 at the upper multiple)
cost_bounds_usd.cap_check: even the worst estimate is far below the shared USD 1.33 cap; the bucket count (33 answers) is the binding limit and charges 33 x 0.001365 in the ledger regardless of tokens
cost_bounds_usd.record: the Anthropic console is the cost of record; report its figure next to the ledger estimate

llm.prerequisite: bucket 16b holds 0 remaining answers after Session 1 (40 used); the human-approved transfer line APPROVED_LLM_TRANSFER=15b->16b:36 must be applied with load-tests/llm_budget.py transfer before the run (36 = 33 for the full run + 1 for the --only q04 probe that runs first + 2 spare; 15b keeps 60 - 36 = 24 remaining answers, 16b becomes 36 remaining); each question asked is charged once, so probe + run charge 34 and 2 stay unused; this manifest never creates or applies an approval
llm.enforcement: load-tests/evalq12.py run charges bucket 16b itself (one ledger answer line before every request, under the ledger lock) and refuses to start when the questions exceed the bucket's remaining answers or the USD 1.33 total; do NOT also run llm_budget.py reserve --bucket 16b for it; the evidence, explain and preflight GET requests call no model
llm.key_handling: the writer needs a real Anthropic key; it is handled by the approved procedure of docs/agent-runs/phase-15 (Q12 key-handling approval), never by this manifest: only an environment variable of the one run process, never a CLI argument, shell tracing off (set +x)
llm.cost_reporting: AWS, Anthropic and Voyage reported as separate items, then the combined total; the local stack has no AWS charge from this run; Voyage tokens are counted inside the service

questions.order: round-robin over the types; the two abstain-expected types (topic, institution) are never adjacent

source.export_dir: target/phase15/p6/size-S/run:ba7402d1-959a-4277-8c6e-e92878a38afa/spark (git-ignored; the plain-CSV neptune-opencypher-csv sidecar is read, no Parquet)

types.coauthor_breadth: ranking by distinct coauthors (3 windows); values-and-order key (per-researcher values are exact; the runtime ranks its artifact population)
types.max_team_size: ranking by maximum team size; all-years values-and-order, two windowed questions bounded (the CSV sidecar has no work years)
types.direct_collab: direct coauthors of one researcher (one with 28 coauthors so the 25-row page truncates); exact key
types.component: component size and id; exact key
types.community: compare communities of one researcher; exact key from an independent port of the synchronous label propagation, replay-validated against analytics-report.json (answer-key.json source.validation); planner route LLM
types.bridge: ranking by cross-community degree (3 windows); values-and-order key
types.temporal: did X change between adjacent stored windows; exact except deltaAverageCoauthorsPerPaper and deltaMaximumCoauthorsOnOnePaper (not checked) and communityJaccardOverlap (a lower bound: the runtime also counts one-person communities of researchers with no edge in a window); planner route LLM
types.topic: THIN DATA (3 TOPIC nodes on one work with no AUTHORED edge): the key expects an abstention (HTTP 200 ABSTAINED or 422 UNSUPPORTED_QUERY)
types.institution: THIN DATA (1 INSTITUTION node, 0 AFFILIATED_WITH edges): the key expects an abstention (HTTP 200 ABSTAINED or 422 UNSUPPORTED_QUERY)
types.evidence: shortest path between two direct coauthors with 2..5 joint works (all-years, since-2015, 2020-2026): the answer must cite the edge evidence whose workIds are exactly the joint works; exact key from the CSV sidecar (the edge row's representative work ids, which for joint <= 5 are exactly the joint works in every window); planner route fallback (the shortest-path form without the word coauthor). The explain / SemanticExplanation form is not used: the local stack has no vectors, so it always abstains there

command.probe: python3 -I load-tests/evalq12.py run --only q04 --run-id <probe-run-id>   (charges 1 answer of the 36; q04 is the direct-coauthor question with 28 coauthors: a 25-row page; one bounded live answer to check the 5 s synthesis deadline before the 33)
command.raw_results: target/experiment-runs/q12-benchmark-<run-id>/raw/ (answers.jsonl with the query answer, the /v1/explain body and every cited /v1/evidence item per question; events.jsonl, run-record.json, raw.sha256), sealed read-only
command.needs: SCHOLARCHAIN_LOAD_BASE_URL (loopback host only) and SCHOLARCHAIN_LOAD_API_KEY in the shell; the ledger created with llm_budget.py init; the include list loaded in the runtime artifact (experiments/inputs/q12/include-ids.txt; the run's preflight refuses otherwise); P3 (direct coauthor budget) and P4 (path abstentions) fixed

run_settings.retrieval_mode: graph (the local stack has no vectors: Voyage keys revoked, S3 Vectors destroyed; the runtime-config default is fused, so the run must override it to graph)

deadline_overrides_ms.note: the coordinator sets the planner and synthesis deadlines to 30,000 ms for the local run (the committed runtime config has plannerMs 5000 and synthesisMs 5000); record them with the run, they are service settings, not harness options

run_settings.record: write these settings, the stack commit and the include-list sha256 into the run evidence next to the run id; the harness records the commit and the tree flag in run-record.json but cannot see the service's configuration
run_settings.consequence: no semantic evidence exists in this mode; every Q12 type is answerable from graph and metric evidence or is a key-expected abstention (topic and institution)

method_note: the runtime artifact is a bounded subset (the include list plus degree-fill up to the row cap), so ranking questions rank only the researchers inside it; the scorer verifies every cited value against the export and the descending order, and reports agreement with the corpus-wide top as information only
open_items: Phase14QuestionSetPlannerSpec equivalent for the 33 questions (rag-engineer): 27 questions are in the fallback grammar (the evidence type is now a fallback-grammar shortest-path form, so the spec's type-to-route rule and counts change from 24/9 to 27/6 and an `evidence` case with params a and b like shortest_path is needed); only temporal and community comparison (6) need the planner LLM
no grading of free-form prose beyond the key facts (numbers, names, hop words); the scorer reports every failure reason
